rationale: A pre-flight pins/roster integrity assay plus a repeat-conformance stability target exercises the S5 §3 change shape end to end while staying minimal and behavior-preserving: the new executable content is gated by advertise-time validation (creation-fixed table, §1.1), the revised pins must be tolerated by every downstream consumer (identity record, suite execution, compat aggregation) exactly as the change leg intends to measure, and the added suite target passes by construction (identical file and expectations to an already-passing sibling, sharing its log file so no base step gains outputs). The assay is self-validating (it schema-checks the revised roster, including the added target) and infallible (all failure modes captured inside its report, exit 0), so the revision adds acceptance signal without adding new failure modes to the base suite semantics.
